answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the spiral forfeiture exposes up in the summit totals with the knoll audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 203 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 25% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
